item.title: Sandoz Warns EU May Scrap Antibiotic Protection, Harm Plant
item.description: Sandoz Group AG said Europe’s medicines regulator is proposing to pull amoxicillin from its list of critical medicines, a potential death blow to the last European factory to make the antibiotic from scratch.

item.title: UK Budget Lacked 'Big Picture Themes,' RBC Capital Says
item.description: Peter Schaffrik, global macro strategist at RBC Capital Markets, and Stephanie Flanders of Bloomberg Economics react to Chancellor of the Exchequer John Healey's UK budget announcement. They speak on Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Healey Raises UK Banks Tax, Vows to Keep Finances Stable
item.description: Chancellor of the Exchequer John Healey pledged fiscal discipline in the face of harsh global economic conditions as he delivered the first budget of Andy Burnham’s new Labour administration. His measures included a plan to impose an additional 3% tax on banks, increasing the existing surcharge to 6%. Bloomberg's Caroline Hepker reports from Westminster. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Investors Jolted by Lula Win Search for Bottom After Brazil Rout
item.description: Investors blindsided by President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva’s re-election are balking at buying into Brazil’s markets after bullish bets on the nation’s assets unraveled spectacularly.

item.title: Barclays Turns to Insurers to Hedge Billions of Data Center Debt
item.description: Barclays Plc is looking to buy default protection on more than $10 billion of debt to finance artificial intelligence infrastructure in a bid to create capacity for more lending as hyperscaler funding needs soar.
